properties.statement:
ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured on main c58305ba8, 2026-10-13; RUN AS THE SKILL, root-cause fetched fresh).

1 OBSERVED: capabilities move at the ship: 192 realized, 114 verified and 72 planned of 382. Components do not: 107 of 109 read planned, and 88 of those have a built allocated capability or a realizing file. understated_status names 87 of them in one roll-up at severity 0.40, and nothing has moved since that check was built on 2026-09-30. Of 82 proposed requirements, 33 are satisfied by a realized or verified capability, and no gap kind asks about a proposed requirement whose work shipped. Of 342 proposed decisions, 27 carry EVOLVES_INTO, and 9 reach a taken-up target: exactly the 9 that decision_overtaken_by_promotion reports. Of the 59 ideas the 10-13 judgement pass ruled built, 47 carry no EVOLVES_INTO. Of the 79 it ruled overtaken, 53 have no edge to the record it named.

2 PRECEDENT: fact:root-cause-a-status-that-falls-behind-reality-is-silent-and-a-superseding-capability-leaves-no-trace-2026-09-30 (here), and fact:root-cause-capabilities-rebuilt-under-new-nodes-left-their-predecessors-planned-and-no-component-status-ever-moved-2026-09-30 (flo2, 1a97fc1f1de4d5d2). Both were answered by detection (understated_status), and flo2's also by a one-off hand reconciliation (7 of 21 components now realized). Neither changed what moves the record.

3 REFUTED:
- "The detectors are too narrow": the promotion detector finds all 9 of the 9 cases the graph can show, and is_parked reads only a parks ruling.
- "Only the owner's word is missing": a component's build status needs no approver (add_component says so), yet only 2 of 109 moved.

4 CAUSE (inferred from the counts and the instructions, not traced per ship): each of these records is kept by hand, defaults to the not-done value, and is moved by nothing at the act that makes it true.
- AGENTS.md's design-record steps, and this session's build briefs, move capability status and register artifacts. None of them moves a component's status or draws EVOLVES_INTO from the idea the build answers. The brainstorm and capture-intent skills ask for EVOLVES_INTO at promotion, not at the ship.
- There is no set_component_status; the only route is calling add_component again.
- Requirement `met` is a hand field the design itself says not to read (report.rs, BL-104).
The CAUSES edge waits for the decision that fixes the class, by the deferred route in fact:root-cause-a-cause-with-no-node-yet-has-a-working-deferred-route-that-no-instruction-names-2026-09-28.

5 PARTLY WRONG AS FIRST STATED: "about 140 open decisions are already built" merged 59 ruled built with 79 ruled overtaken, both by reading. About 100 of those 138 rulings rest on reading alone, with no edge a query could check.

6 COULD NOT ESTABLISH: per ship, whether the session that built a thing saw the 0.40 finding or the open idea and chose not to act.
